text:
olivia: Heads-up: planning a staging handoff across API/runtime/console/router at 23:30 UTC tonight. Need pin transfer & deploybot wave. Anyone on-call?

sam: I'm on-call until 00:00 UTC, can shepherd the canary. What's the pin list?

olivia: pin runtime->v3, router->v7, console->v5, api->v12. We'll do 5% canary for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then full.

jess: Add me for observability - I'll watch traces and model latency. Set alert thresholds pls.

olivia: Rollback criteria (short): p99 +50ms sustained 10m OR 5xx rate > 0.7% over 5m OR Canary error rate doubling. Also, if KV eviction climbs >3% in any shard, abort.

sam: Noted. I'll keep the quiet window flag on. Also propose 'eviction-escrow' cushion: reserve 10% spare capacity in runtime pool to avoid noisy evictions.

kai: +1 on eviction-escrow. How do we enforce pin transfer? Deploybot command?

deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled wave locked until confirmation. To start run:

```
/deploy wave --pin api:v12 runtime:v3 router:v7 console:v5 \
  --canary 5%:15m,25%:10m --quiet-window 23:15-23:50 \
  --notes "staging handoff; eviction-escrow=10%" 
```

olivia: That looks right. Sam can you run it at 23:25 to prime the pool? I'll trigger confirm at 23:30.

sam: Will run at :23:25 and monitor. Jess, Kai you'll get paging for p99 & 5xx?

jess: Yep. I'll hook 1-min alerts and open a short grafana dashboard.

kai: I'll put a log filter for KV eviction metric and an SLO watch.

deploybot: deploybot: Wave queued, precheck OK. Health checks: schema compatibility OK, model cache warmup passed, routing handshake ok.

olivia: If anything goes weird we abort and pinback to previous variants. Rollback command:

```
/deploy rollback --target api:prev runtime:prev router:prev console:prev --reason "canary-failure"
```

sam: Understood. I'll keep notes in release doc and post final release notes after window.

olivia: Thanks all. See you in the window. :thumbsup:
